setting.adaptivePlot.detail: Concentrates sample points where the curve bends sharply instead of spacing them evenly. Produces smoother plots of curved functions at a lower point count; disable for a fixed dense sampling.
setting.adaptivePlot.label: Adaptive plotting
setting.colorScale.label: Plot color scale
setting.complex.label: Complex numbers
setting.decimals.label: Decimals
setting.degrees.label: Angle units
setting.formatEquations.detail: Professional (checked) renders equations in stacked math form; Inline (unchecked) renders them on a single line.
setting.formatEquations.label: Format equations
setting.maxOutputCount.detail: Maximum number of rows/columns shown for large matrices and vectors (5-100).
setting.maxOutputCount.label: Max output count
setting.plotHeight.detail: Height of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotHeight = … line.
setting.plotHeight.label: Plot height
setting.plotStep.detail: Mesh size for map (surface) plotting in pixels; 0 lets Calcpad choose automatically. Can be overridden per-document with a PlotStep = … line.
setting.plotStep.label: Plot mesh step
setting.plotWidth.detail: Width of the plot area in pixels (at least 1). Can be overridden per-document with a PlotWidth = … line.
setting.plotWidth.label: Plot width
setting.precision.detail: Relative precision for numerical methods such as integration and root finding (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Precision = … line.
setting.precision.label: Numerical precision
setting.shadows.label: Plot shadows
setting.showHiddenOutput.detail: Ignore #hide so suppressed content is rendered anyway. For debugging.
setting.showHiddenOutput.label: Show hidden output
setting.smoothScale.label: Smooth color scale
setting.substitute.label: Substitute variables
setting.tol.detail: Target tolerance for the iterative PCG solver and eigensolver (1e-15 to 1e-2). Can be overridden per-document with a Tol = … line.
setting.tol.label: Solver tolerance
setting.vectorGraphics.detail: Renders plots as SVG (scalable, sharp at any zoom) instead of raster PNG images.
setting.vectorGraphics.label: Vector graphics
setting.zeroSmallMatrixElements.detail: Display very small matrix/vector values as 0 instead of using scientific notation.
setting.zeroSmallMatrixElements.label: Zero small matrix elements
settings.diagnostics.logsFolderTip: Opens the folder containing server logs and the most recent crash dump.
settings.diagnostics.maxConsoleTip: How many console lines one preview render may relay before the rest are dropped. A worksheet whose scripts log in a loop can otherwise flood the console channel. Raise it when debugging a script, lower it when a library is noisy. Each line is clipped to 4 KB regardless.
settings.diagnostics.maxOutputLinesTip: Lines retained in each Output channel before older lines are dropped. Lower values reduce memory use and improve responsiveness when logs are noisy.
settings.diagnostics.maxPreviewSizeTip: A worksheet that renders to more HTML than this is not shown in the preview - showing it risks running the app out of memory. Exporting to PDF, HTML or DOCX is unaffected. Raise it only if you need very large documents on screen.
settings.editor.autoInputModeTip: A document declaring #UI controls opens as its input form the first time you open it.
settings.editor.autoRunTip: When off, the preview only re-renders when it is first opened or a manual run is triggered.
settings.editor.cursorSyncTip: Scroll the preview to follow the line the cursor is on in the editor.
settings.editor.fontFamilyTip: JuliaMono is the bundled default. Drop .woff2/.woff/.ttf/.otf files into the fonts folder to make them available here.
settings.editor.fontsFolderTip: Open the folder where custom fonts can be dropped. Reopen the Font Family picker to pick up new fonts.
settings.editor.formattingHotkeysTip: Ctrl+B for bold, Ctrl+I for italic, etc.
settings.editor.uiOverridesTip: Preview normally shows the document's own values. Turn this on to render it with the values entered into the input form instead, for tracking down an error that only appears once a form is filled in.
settings.language.failed: That language could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
settings.language.help: Changes the language of the menus and dialogs at once. Worksheet text, units and formulas are never translated. The languages other than English are machine drafts that no native speaker has reviewed yet, and anything not yet translated shows in English. A language you have not opened online before is not available offline.
settings.language.label: Interface language:
settings.language.title: Language
settings.libraries.errAddress: Enter the full address of one file, starting with https://.
settings.libraries.errFetch: Could not fetch the file ({reason}). The site must allow cross-origin requests, which public CDNs do.
settings.libraries.errFolder: Enter the address of one file, not a folder or a whole site.
settings.libraries.errHttps: Only https:// addresses can be added.
settings.libraries.hint: Worksheet scripts may load only these files, each from its exact address and checked against its hash. Anything else is blocked and the preview names it.
settings.libraries.name: Name
settings.libraries.title: Libraries
settings.tabs.label: Settings sections
settings.units.nonMetricTip: Selects US or UK definitions for bare unit names that differ between the two systems (gal, ton, cwt, pt, qt, bbl, tonf, therm, etc.).
